data.comment:
# Comfy Seedance2.0- First-Last-Frame to Video

Upload the first and last frames of your video. Generate a high-quality video sequence using the Seedance2.0 model. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_seedance2_0_flf2v.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.

data.model.prompt: Cinematic drone perspective shot, smooth camera movement: drone flies forward from behind the character, then rotates 180 degrees to look back at the character, then slowly pushes up and ascends, first frame: character's back walking through golden sunset flower field with city skyline in distance, last frame: character facing camera in wide aerial shot of endless flower sea, warm golden hour backlighting, lens flare, soft wind blowing petals, hyper-detailed 8K, photorealistic, cinematic color grading
